preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some BURNING tokens to initiate the attack
Trading must be enabled (tradingEnabled = true) and the contract must have accumulated fees in buyAmount/sellAmount
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true and contract token balance must be >= swapTokensAtAmount

exploit_hint: The reentrancy vulnerability exists in the swapAndSendDividends function which calls external contracts (dividendTracker, marketingWallet, devWallet) via low-level calls without following checks-effects-interactions pattern. Create a malicious contract that triggers a reentrant call back to the EthBurn contract's transfer function during the dividend distribution. The attack flow: 1) Ensure contract has accumulated fees (buyAmount/sellAmount > 0), 2) Trigger a transfer that will cause swapAndSendDividends to execute, 3) During the external call to dividendTracker or marketing/dev wallets, re-enter the contract through a fallback function that calls transfer again, 4) Exploit the state variables (buyAmount, sellAmount) not being updated before external calls to drain funds multiple times.
